body.name: All-active full-rank row-law interior \(\mathcal U_{\mathrm{rr}}\)
body.construction: \(\mathcal U_{\mathrm{rr}}=\{P:\lambda_{\min}\{K_{D_t^{\star}D_t^{\star}}(P)\}>\underline\kappa\text{ for every }1\le t<T,\text{ and }\rho_t(P)>\underline\rho\text{ for every }0\le t<T\}\), where \(D_t^{\star}=\{0,\ldots,t-1\}\).
